title: Chapter 6: The Singing Lava-Tubes & The 95.5°F Obsidian Cove (Stardate 49602.3)
summary: Following a ribbon-smooth volcanic basalt causeway inland—an alien mirror of the Huckleberry Trail—the family discovers a piezoelectric crystal lava-tube cavern that acts as a natural 45-second reverb chamber and a terraced geothermal caldera whose lower lagoon is naturally buffered at a therapeutic 95.5°F.
